description: Construction of single-storey side infill extension featuring a pitched glazed roof. Replacement front elevation windows with double-glazed timber sash windows to match originals. Enlargement rear ground floor window openings. Installation of timber and aluminium windows and doors to rear elevation, replacing existing units. Replacement of second-floor dormer with energy-efficient dormer replicating.  New dormer to side roof slope, matching dormer in form and material, with integrated doors and window. Raising ground floor platform at front of property to align with neighbouring levels, incorporating new glazed blocks. Installation of boundary treatments to front at ground floor level and terrace at second floor level. New front door and stone paving slabs to front steps. Replacement slate roof tiles with new tiles to match. New AC external unit
